synopsis: Scheduled to be released in September 2026. WHEN NEGOTIATIONS FAIL, THE EMPIRE SENDS IN ITS ATTACK DOG - DARTH VADER! Director Orson Krennic's negotiations with the gem-rich planet of Harreld have hit a standstill. Its leader, Harqque, refuses to allow the Empire to mine its rare kyber deposits for use in the Death Star's deadly super laser. But when the Emperor catches wind of Krennic's failure, he sends his most trusted acolyte - Darth Vader - to ply the kyber from Harqque by any means necessary.
title: Rogue One: Darth Vader #1
